name: step1-llm-score-output
summary: Added SCORE instructions and post-completion parsing across all providers and the legacy OpenAI fallback.
completed_work: Added SCORE prompt instructions to OpenAI, Grok, OpenRouter, Kimi, and legacy OpenAI client prompts.
Implemented a single shared parseScoreFromResult() helper in lib/providers/openai.ts and reused it from other provider paths.
Parsed completed non-streaming provider responses after section splitting and returned score with each provider ReviewResult.
Parsed legacy processDocumentReview() results and returned optional score for storage.
decisions: Kept SCORE parsing out of reviewStream() implementations so parsing only happens after complete non-streaming responses.
Allowed parseScoreFromResult() to handle SCORE on either the first line or the next line after a section heading because existing multi-item parsing preserves section titles.
Left storage and upload mapping unchanged in this step because the blocking-fix step already added the score storage contract.
known_issues: Existing unrelated .gitignore and step0-step3 markdown edits remain in the worktree and were not reverted.
SCORE values are optional at storage time; older or malformed model responses will save without a score.
next_actions: Proceed to step2-score-display-ui to render score badges in the review result dialog.
resume_hint: Read phases/5-scoring-prompt-edit/step2.md and components/documents/document-review-dialog.tsx. ReviewResult.score is now available on stored review results.
